title: Customer menu dark mode
objective: Give the customer-facing menu a dark mode with an explicit toggle, defaulting to the visitor's system preference and remembering their choice.
context: Proposed, not approved, and not implemented. The customer menu is currently light-only. Staff dashboards are out of scope: they are used during service and a colour change there is a separate, higher-risk decision. This task touches presentation only — no Messenger, ordering, payment, n8n or Supabase behaviour may change.
acceptanceCriteria: Dark mode applies to the customer menu only.
A clearly visible, labelled light/dark toggle is available on the customer menu.
With no stored preference, the theme follows the system preference (prefers-color-scheme).
An explicit choice is persisted and survives a page reload.
Text and interactive elements meet WCAG AA contrast in both themes.
Messenger, ordering, payment, n8n and Supabase behaviour are unchanged.
typecheck, lint and build all pass.
stoppingRules: Stop if any change is needed outside allowedPaths.
Stop if a staff dashboard file would be modified.
Stop if any Messenger, ordering, payment, n8n or Supabase code path would change.
Stop if the same check fails identically twice.
Stop and escalate as NEEDS_HUMAN after two revision rounds.
